title: What to Do If a Shark Comes Close: 65 Confirmed Unprovoked Bites in 2025 🦈 (Would Meatball Survive?)
description:
What to do if a shark comes close? The International Shark Attack File's tips: keep eye contact with the shark, slowly move away, and if possible, get out of the water. If a shark bites, hit the eyes and gills, and do not act passively. It advises swimming with a buddy, staying close to shore, and not swimming at dawn or dusk. It confirmed 65 unprovoked shark bites on people worldwide in 2025, and the Florida Museum says the chances of being bitten remain extremely low.
